book.name: HEBREWS
book.title: HEBREW sinmuy amuṅaqw Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēni

content: God Our Father
Noqw itam it akw moṅwvastotiqamuy akw ṅö́yakiwtaqe, ōviy itam qa náṅ’ekni’k̇ahk̇aṅw nanamunwani; nen a’nö yuhtukni. Itam sohsok hihta puptut o’yani, pu sohsok qaanhtiput itamuy ṅuy’yuṅqata.

Itam Jesus aw‐sa taywisni, itahqapevewniy yayhnaqat pu yúkuhqat aw’i. Pam hapi hahlayhpit makiwniqey tunatyawk̇aṅw nahoylehtsit ep mokqey aṅ kuyva, nahaman’ewakw qa hihtatat’a, nihqe God moṅw’atsvewayat putvaqe qatuptu.
Noqw ōviy uma put aṅ wūwayani, hin pam nakwhani’taqata, hakim qaanhinwisqam put aw rohomhtotiq’ö. Uma put aṅ wūwaye’, soon wuwanmamaṅwuy’yani, pu ókiwhtotini.
Uma qa haqawa qaanhtiput aw rohomnumhqey ep mōki.
Ya tutuveni umuy God tímatnihqat pan ökwhantaqat uma pay suhtokya? Ura yan pey’ta: Itii, Tutuyqawhqa uṅ ökwhantaqw, um put qa paysoqtani, pu pam uṅ sivintoynaqw, um put ep qa pas unaṅwmokmantani.
Pi Tutuyqawhqa hakiy aw unaṅway’te’, hakiy ökwhaṅwu, pu qa hakiy tiy kwúsuhqey qa wuvahtaṅwu.
Kurs uma ökwhaniwyaqey aṅ kuyyuṅqw, pep hapi pu’ God umuy tímuy’taniqey pan tumaltani. Puyaw haqam hakiy tiat nayat ahpiy qa ökwhaniwa?
Pi itam sohsoyam hīhihta ep ökwhaniwya; noqw kurs hak qa hihta ep ökwhaniwe’, pep pu’ soñawnen pam pay hakiy qa puwsuṅway’k̇aṅw tihtaqat tiyat antani, nihqe pay qa God tíatni.
Yep qatsit ep itanam itamuy ökwhantotaqw, itam pumuy k̇aptsi’yuṅwa. Noqw ya sen itam tis hīhikwsimuy yúkuhqat aw tūqayyuṅwe’, soon qa yesni?
Itanam pi pay as antsa pan unaṅwtote’, hihsavo itamuy ökwhantotaṅwu. Noqw God hapi itamuy akw moṅwvastotiniqat ōviy panhtiṅwu, itam put an qahováriwyuṅwniqat ōviy’o.
Noqw nāp hak ökwhaniwhqey ep soon hahlayhtimantani; nīk̇aṅw pay atsva hak put aṅ kuyve’ kwakwhat unaṅway’vaṅwu, piw suan hinmaṅwuniqey tuwi’vaṅwu.
Instructions and Warnings
Oviy hakiy unaṅwmokq, maat súhayiwtaqw uma öqalayani; pu hakiy tamöat qaöqáwi’taqw uma put hoṅvitotani.
Nen uma soñawnen hakimuy kukyamuy eṅem suwip pöhtotani; nāp hisat hakiy kuk’at qa pasiwtaqat ȫqaat ruhpakni; pam qa panhtit qalaptuni.
Uma sohsokmuy amumum kwakwhat qatsit aṅ ö’qalyani, pu qahovársqatsit aṅ’a. Put uma ṅastaye’, soon Tutuyqawhqat aw yórikyani.
Uma pās tunatyawwisni, taq sen haqawa God núokwayat qa akw moṅwvastini, taq nāp hisat hak tūsaqat a’nö tsīvot anhte’ wūhaknihqamuy hovalani.
Uma tunatyaltotini, taq nāp hisat haqawa tokot sokoplawni; sen yep qatsit‐sa aw tunatyawtani, Esaut an’i. Ura pam motitinihqe makiway sūs nösniqey aw aptsiwtaqat ōviy put nāhoyṅwa.
Noqw ura ahpiy pantaqw, put naat put öqalaniqat pam nāwakna. Noqw pay ayo noiwa, soon kurs pam hiniwhtiqat alöṅtaniqw ōviy’o, nāmahin pi as ura okiw pas pakk̇aṅw hin put alöṅtaniqey hepta.
Pi uma tūkwit Sinait qa aw öki, imuy Israel‐sinmuy amún’i. Ura pam tūkwi uwiwik̇aṅw pamesit akw nömseekiwk̇aṅw, qatāla, pu piw huk’ohpokiwta.
Pu paṅqw hak tȫtökqe hiṅqawlawhq, puma put tönayat nanapta; nihqe puma put nanaptaqe, as pam pāpu qa pumuy amumi yuaataniqat okiw yan tūviṅtota,
Pas kurs puma soon hin tutaptiwhqat aṅ kuyyuṅwniqe ōviy’o, pi ura paṅqawu: Nīk̇aṅw híkispi pay himuvohko tūkiwt aw toṅokq, pay tatam uma put tatatupninayamantani, sen lansat akw nīnayamantani.
Noqw ura kurs pi pas nuhtsel’ewakw soniwhq, ōviy Moses paṅqawu: Pas nu pavan tsawnaqe, tururuyku.
Pi uma hapi tūkwit Zion aw öki, pu pas qátuhqat God wuhkokitsokiyat, ōveqatsit ep Jerusalem aw’i; God hoṅviaymuyatuy qaan’ewakw hintaqamuy amumii;

Pu sūmi tsovawtaqamuy mohti tihtiwhqat aw tōnawtaqamuy túṅwniam ōveqatsit ep pey’yuṅqa pumuy amumii; pu sohsokmuy amuṅem hin yuki’maqat God aw’i; pu aṅ suan hinyuṅqamuy sinmuy hikwsiam hinyuṅwniqey aṅ pās pasiwhtotiqamuy amumii:
It puhuvasiwnit ep God‐nik̇aṅw pu sinmuy amuhtsave hintsakqat Jesus aw’i; pu put uṅwáyat wiwtsiniwyaniqat Abel uṅwáyat epnihqe pavan hihta núnukṅwat tuawi’taqat aw’i.

Uma tunatyaltote’ hakiy ōṅaqw yuaataqat aw tūqayyuṅwni. Susmataqpi ima hakiy tūwaqatsit ep yuaaykuqat aw qa tūqayyuṅqam pas ayo qa nöṅa. Noqw pay tis itam hakiy ōṅaqw yuaaykuqat aw qa tūqayyuṅwe’, kurs hin ayo nöṅakni.
Ura hakiy tönaat ephaqam pas tūwaqatsit tayayaykina; noqw pu’ hapi pam hinhtiniqey lavayhtiqe paṅqawu: Sūs piw nāt nu qa tūwaqatsit‐sanit pay ōveqatsit enaṅ tayayaykinani.
Noqw pam sūs piw sohsok hihta tayayaykinaniqey paṅqawhqe, hihta tayayaykuqat sohsok súlawhtiniqat paṅqawu; pay aṅ hihta yukiwhqat hapi; noqw aṅ himu soon wayayaykuniqa hūrs hoṅvani.
Noqw ōviy hapi itam moṅwtunatyat pas soon wayayaykuniqat makiwyaqe, itam put ep God tsúyakyani; nen itam k̇aptsi’k̇ahk̇aṅw pas hihtay’k̇ahk̇aṅw put aw okiwlalwe’, put unaṅwveyani.
Taq aw itahyantaqa God qȫhi hihta tsohtso’naṅwuqat anta.
